question: Who among the following joined the 969 Railway Engineer Regiment of Territorial Army (TA) in 2011? She was the first female jawan in the Indian Army.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sapper Shanti Tigga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sapper Shanti Tigga joined the **969 Railway Engineer Regiment **of **Territorial Army (TA)** in **2011**.
 
• She was the **first female jawan **in the **Indian Army**.
 
• Her induction marked a significant milestone in the Indian Army's history, showcasing the increasing roles of women in the armed forces.
 
• She was noted for her physical fitness and determination, which helped her succeed in a traditionally male-dominated field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Women in Indian Army:**

 
 
• Women were first inducted into the Indian Army in **1992 **as officers in non-combat roles.
 
• In recent years, the roles of women in the Indian Army have expanded significantly, including positions in combat support arms and services.
 
• The Indian Army has taken several initiatives to increase the participation of women, reflecting a broader trend towards gender equality in the armed forces.
 
 
 
• **Territorial Army (TA):**
 
 
• The Territorial Army is a **part-time voluntary force **that provides support to the regular army during emergencies and national defense operations.
 
• It allows civilians to serve in the military while maintaining their civilian careers.
 
• The TA has been actively involved in various operations, including disaster relief, internal security, and infrastructure development.
